LanguageData.SandWorm_Thing_Desc: A gigantic sand-dwelling leviathan that tunnels through the map, crushes anything in its path, and answers the signal of a sand hammer.
LanguageData.SandHammer_Desc: A vibration device used to lure a deep-sand leviathan. The sand hammer repeatedly strikes the ground and releases low-frequency echoes, imitating the seismic mating signal of a sandworm. Deploy it in the marked desert zone to draw out the creature hiding below.
LanguageData.SandWorm_Quest_Site_Inspect: A deep-sand echo zone marked by the Syndicate. The underground resonance here is highly unstable, making it suitable for deploying a sand hammer and drawing out the leviathan below.
LanguageData.SandWorm_Quest_Site_CleanupCountdown: The Syndicate reports that the underground echoes are fading. This zone will collapse and close in {0}.
LanguageData.SandWorm_Quest_Site_RetryPending: The previous attempt has been interrupted. The Syndicate is redeploying a sand hammer, and the target area will be regenerated the next time you enter.
LanguageData.SandWorm_Quest_NeedSandHammer: Your caravan must be carrying a sand hammer to enter the deep-sand echo zone.
LanguageData.SandWorm_Quest_NoDesertTile: No suitable desert target area could be found on the world map, so the contract cannot be deployed.
LanguageData.SandWorm_Quest_SandHammerArrived_Text: The Syndicate's mission equipment has arrived by drop pod. A sand hammer is now ready. Carry it to the marked deep-sand echo zone and deploy it to imitate a sandworm mating signal and lure the leviathan out.
LanguageData.SandWorm_Quest_SiteCreated_Text: The coordinates provided by the Syndicate have been marked: {0}. Travel there and deploy the sand hammer to imitate a sandworm mating signal and draw the leviathan from the deep sands.
LanguageData.SandWorm_Quest_SandHammer_Activated: The sand hammer has bitten into the deep sand. Its low-frequency echoes are now imitating a sandworm mating signal. The Syndicate's monitoring window estimates that the leviathan below will awaken in ten hours.
LanguageData.SandWorm_Quest_SandHammer_WrongMap: The sand hammer detects no deep-sand resonance from the Syndicate's marked zone. It can only be deployed inside the deep-sand echo zone.
LanguageData.SandWorm_Quest_Spawned: The deep sands churn. The giant sandworm marked by the Syndicate has been successfully lured out by the sand hammer!
LanguageData.SandWorm_Quest_Spawned_Text: The Syndicate confirms that the sand hammer's simulated mating signal has awakened the leviathan beneath the deep sands. An abnormal sandstorm is engulfing the area, and the giant sandworm is approaching from the edge of the map!
LanguageData.SandWorm_Quest_LeviathanKilled_Text: The giant sandworm has finally sunk into the deep sand, leaving only torn ridges and fading echoes behind. The Syndicate confirms that the leviathan is dead. The deep-sand echo zone will destabilize and close in twelve hours. In two days, a shipment of luciferium will be drop-podded to your colony as payment.
LanguageData.SandWorm_Quest_LuciferiumReward_Text: The Syndicate has kept its promise. 200 luciferium has been delivered to the colony by drop pod as payment for killing the leviathan.
LanguageData.SandWorm_Quest_RetrySandHammer_Label: Syndicate resupply: new sand hammer delivered
LanguageData.SandWorm_Quest_RetrySandHammer_Text: The Syndicate's monitoring window confirms that the hunt inside the deep-sand echo zone has been interrupted. The target leviathan has sunk back beneath the sand, and the current challenge map will destabilize and close. The contract will not fail. A replacement sand hammer has been drop-podded to your main colony. Regroup, then return to the deep-sand echo zone to try again.
LanguageData.SandWorm_Quest_Description_Syndicate:
A mysterious organization calling itself the Syndicate has contacted the colony through an encrypted channel. They claim to have located a leviathan-class sandworm in the deep sands. This creature has long lurked beneath the desert and is drawn to large-scale industrial noise, shifting wealth, and underground vibrations. The Syndicate refuses to intervene openly and will only hire you as contractors to remove the threat.
If you accept, the Syndicate will drop-pod a sand hammer for luring the beast and mark a deep-sand echo zone on the world map. Deploy the sand hammer in the target area and it will repeatedly strike the ground, imitating the low-frequency seismic mating signal of a sandworm. After ten hours of accumulated vibration, the leviathan beneath the sand will surface. The Syndicate promises that the final payment will be delivered to your colony by drop pod after the kill.
LanguageData.SandWorm_Syndicate_TabBody: Select a high-risk contract marked by the Syndicate. Each challenge records its target, intelligence, and follow-up actions.
LanguageData.SandWorm_Challenge_SandSeaLeviathan_Summ: A low-frequency echo rises from the deep sands. The Syndicate has located a leviathan-class sandworm.
LanguageData.SandWorm_Challenge_SandSeaLeviathan_Deta: Challenge content: accept the Syndicate contract, carry the sand hammer to the deep-sand echo zone, deploy the lure signal, kill the sand leviathan that surfaces, and wait for the Syndicate to deliver payment.
LanguageData.SandWorm_Contract_Subtitle: Syndicate high-risk contract terminal: choose operators, stack risk tags, and confirm the intensity of this desert operation.
LanguageData.SandWorm_Contract_NoPawns: No free colonists detected in player home maps.
LanguageData.SandWorm_Contract_FooterSummary: Operators: {0} Contract level: {1} Launching will enter a temporary Syndicate challenge space.
LanguageData.SandWorm_Contract_StartNeedPawn: Select at least one operator first.
LanguageData.SandWorm_Contract_StartPreview: Challenge terminal confirmed: {0} operators, contract level {1}.
LanguageData.SandWorm_SyndicateChallenge_AlreadyActiv: A Syndicate challenge is already running. You cannot start another one yet.
LanguageData.SandWorm_SyndicateChallenge_StartFailed: The Syndicate challenge space failed to initialize.
LanguageData.SandWorm_SyndicateChallenge_Started_Text: The Syndicate has unfolded a temporary deep-sand space. {0} operators have been deployed to the challenge map. Current contract level: {1}. The sandworm echo will arrive in 10 seconds.
LanguageData.SandWorm_SyndicateChallenge_WormSpawned_: The resonance inside the deep-sand space has reached its threshold. The sand leviathan is approaching from the map edge, and an abnormal sandstorm is unfolding.
LanguageData.SandWorm_SyndicateChallenge_ShockwaveWar: Seismic shock lanes are locking on. Leave the red fissures or take cover behind raised stone.
LanguageData.SandWorm_SyndicateChallenge_ResonancePre: Underground resonance is destabilizing. Small sandworm wave {0} is approaching from the map edge.
LanguageData.SandWorm_SyndicateChallenge_Returned: {0} has been recovered by the Syndicate and returned to the colony at full health.
LanguageData.SandWorm_SyndicateChallenge_Failed_Text: All operators have been recovered from the deep-sand space. The Syndicate marks this Sea of Sand Leviathan challenge as failed, and the temporary challenge map is being destroyed.
LanguageData.SandWorm_Settings_EnableWorldDestruction: Allow sandworms to destroy buildings and reshape terrain
When disabled, sandworms will still move and attack living targets, but they will not destroy buildings, remove roofs, or convert terrain to sand.
LanguageData.SandWorm_Settings_ShowShockwaveWarningLi: When enabled, Syndicate shockwave warnings draw seismic danger lanes, moving arrows, and cover state; leaving the lane or hiding behind raised stone avoids damage.
LanguageData.SandWorm_Settings_HitProxyDebugRectsDesc: Green = body hit proxy, red = head hit proxy, white cross = proxy center. Use this to check whether weapons can correctly hit the sandworm.
LanguageData.SandWorm_Settings_PressureDebugDesc: Yellow = crush, cyan = shove, red = head instant-kill. Used for debugging hit zone widths.
LanguageData.SandWorm_Difficulty_Terror: I am the face of terror
